hero.intro2: we're getting married and throwing a big party! Woohoo! We want to celebrate this magnificently with all of you. We invite you to spend a beautiful weekend with us - eating, drinking, chatting, playing, celebrating and dancing. The party will take place in the heart of the Swabian Alb at Alb Schlosshof. A lovely spot, surrounded by forests and meadows, that calls for a vacation and invites you to relax and celebrate. We're looking forward to it.

footer.line1: We're looking forward to seeing you!
